errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies F1 as a model. F1 is a performance metric (F1-score) shown in the legend, not the name of the model being evaluated.
At x=1, the two lines have values of approximately 77.2% (F1) and 75.8% (Acc). The stated value of 68% is far below the actual values and is outside the displayed y-axis range of 74-80.
At x=8, the two lines have values of approximately 75.8% (F1) and 75.0% (Acc). The stated value of 74% is below both lines.
The red line (F1) starts at x=1 with a value of approximately 77.2%, not 68%. The value 68% is outside the y-axis range shown in the plot.
The red line (F1) is not stable between x=1 and x=5. It fluctuates, rising from x=1 to x=2, dipping at x=3, and then rising again to its peak at x=5.
The red line (F1) ends at x=8 with a value of approximately 75.8%. While close, 76% is an imprecise approximation for the final data point.
The blue line (Acc) does not decrease between x=1 and x=5. Instead, it generally rises from approximately 75.8% at x=1 to its peak of approximately 77.3% at x=5.
After peaking at x=5, the blue line (Acc) decreases for the rest of the range, ending at approximately 75.0% at x=8. It does not rise.
The description fails to mention the y-axis label "%", which indicates that the values are percentages.
The description does not mention the markers used to distinguish the lines (red circles for F1 and blue triangles for Acc), which are explicitly shown in the legend.
